Fixtures for the 2024–25 season were announced on 1 September 2024.{{cite web|url=https://www.vetogate.com/5228301 |title=قرعة دوري المحترفين، مواجهات مثيرة في الأسبوع الأول |trans-title=Professionals League draw: Exciting fixtures in week one |website=Veto Gate |language=Arabic |date=1 September 2024 |accessdate=1 September 2024}} The season started on 7 October 2024, and concluded on 31 May 2025.{{cite web|url=https://www.youm7.com/story/2024/8/26/%D8%A7%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%83%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D9%8A%D8%AD%D8%AF%D8%AF-%D9%85%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%B9%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%B7%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%82-%D8%AF%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%89-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AD%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%81%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%82%D8%B3%D9%85%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AB%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%89-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AB%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AB/6685016 |title=اتحاد الكرة يحدد مواعيد انطلاق دورى المحترفين والقسمين الثانى والثالث |trans-title=EFA announces start dates for Professionals, second and third division leagues |website=[[Youm7]] |language=Arabic |date=26 August 2024 |accessdate=1 September 2024}}{{cite web|url=https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/3265253 |title=قبل انطلاق النسخة الثانية.. كل ما تريد معرفته عن دوري المحترفين المصري |trans-title=Before the second edition kicks-off: Here's everything you need to know about the new season of the Professionals League |website=[[Al-Masry Al-Youm|Al Masry Al Youm]] |language=Arabic |date=22 September 2024 |accessdate=25 September 2024}} ==Format== Per the [[Egyptian Football Association]] decision made on 9 August 2023, the 2024–25 edition's format differs from the previous season. The league consists of 20 teams in one group, with all teams playing each other twice, home and away, for a total of thirty-eight matches. The first-placed team is crowned champions of the league, and earns promotions to the [[Egyptian Premier League]] alongside the runners-up and third-placed team, while the bottom three teams face relegation to the [[Egyptian Second Division B]].{{cite web|url=https://www.shorouknews.com/news/view.aspx?cdate=09082023&id=6209e5ee-1331-46e6-a9fa-9f1af6f47d5b |title=تعديل جديد في نظام دوري المحترفين بداية من موسم 2024-2025 |trans-title=Professionals League format to be adjusted starting from the 2024–25 season |website=Shorouk News |language=Arabic |date=9 August 2023 |accessdate=7 March 2024}} On May 18, 2025, the Egyptian Pro League Association confirmed that four teams will be promoted from the second division to the Premier League for the following season.{{cite web |url=https://www.kingfut.com/2025/05/18/major-egyptian-premier-league-reforms-no-relegation-expanded-league-for-next-season/ |title=Major Egyptian Premier League Reforms: No Relegation, Expanded League for Next Season |publisher=KingFut |date=18 May 2025 }} However, only three teams were promoted to the Premier League.{{cite web
